decision.summary: A confirmed temporary offset spans indices 590–609: N and E show opposing trends with reversal, and U exhibits a coincident transient dip that recovers synchronously. The onset, interior evolution, and return are observable on all three axes, satisfying the criteria for a complete temporary interval. No other intervals in [555,650] meet the required coherence of onset–sustained–return across axes.

intervals.observation: N declines from ~21.5 to ~19.3 (indices 590–604), E rises from ~20.1 to ~22.2 (590–604), then both reverse: N recovers to ~21.0 by 609, E drops to ~20.4; U dips sharply at ~600 (from ~24.8 to ~20.5) and recovers by 609. Onset (~590), sustained interior (591–608), and return (~605–609) are coherent across axes, supporting a single temporary offset.
